wins.label: Customer Acquisition Progress
wins.evidence: We have a -- a number we've always tracked and it's our core accounts. It was maybe more meaningful statistic when we were branch-based and opening branches. But last year, our core accounts... this year, they're up about 7%.

risks.label: Customer Spending Decline

wins.label: Onsite Support in Sweeny, Texas
wins.evidence: Dan Florness shared a story about an Onsite in Sweeny, Texas, supporting a Phillips 66 refining facility during a hurricane, emphasizing 'we've got your back' and providing support during chaotic situations.

wins.label: Florida Retirement Community Support
wins.evidence: Dan Florness discussed a story about a retirement community in Florida without power after a hurricane, highlighting the importance of proactively checking on vulnerable populations.

wins.label: Fastenal Intelligence Launch
wins.evidence: Holden Lewis detailed the launch of Fastenal Intelligence, a robust AI-powered system utilizing data to provide well-thought-out answers and source information, replacing the previous 130,000 Q&A pairs.

wins.label: Customer Acquisition Improvements
wins.evidence: Dan Florness highlighted the improved Onsite and FMI signings and low double-digit growth in national contract accounts, attributing it to better alignment and a sharpened focus on sales.

wins.label: FMI Technology Growth
wins.evidence: Holden Lewis reported that FMI Technology had grown to 119,000 weighted devices, representing an 11% increase from last year, driven by increased signings and a focus on improving facility efficiency.

risks.label: Prolonged Macroeconomic Downturn
risks.evidence: Holden Lewis emphasized the extended duration of sub-50 Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) readings, citing 16 consecutive months and 19 out of 20 months, indicating a challenging industrial environment.

risks.label: Pricing Pressure
risks.evidence: Holden Lewis acknowledged ongoing price deflation in fastener products and potential pressure from competitors, coupled with a shift in customer behavior.

risks.label: Inventory Management Challenges
risks.evidence: Holden Lewis noted the need to manage inventory levels effectively, particularly with the increased FMI deployments and the potential for slower growth in the near term.

risks.label: Uncertainty Regarding Election Impact
risks.evidence: Dan Florness declined to comment on the potential impact of the upcoming election, acknowledging the uncertainty surrounding economic forecasts.

risks.label: Mature Onsite Performance
risks.evidence: Dan Florness discussed the challenges associated with mature Onsite locations, where customer activity and sales performance were influenced by broader macroeconomic trends.
